INSTALL

Note: Please make sure you check the system requirements detailed in the README file before proceeding.
--------------
 INSTALLATION
--------------

You can find the latest application version on the official website (http://pmc.rudisoft.net).

Download the archived application source. Please note that there is no difference between the .zip and the .tgz file.
They are provided for convenience only.

Unpack the archive somewhere on your computer. You should end up with a folder called "pmc" with some files and directories in it.

Upload the files and directories in "pmc" to your server

Change permissions to 777 to the following files/directories:
./inc/cfg.inc.php
./var/pic_cat/
./var/pic_mov/

Open your favourite web browser and point it to your installation on the server.
The application automatically detects that it is not set up and you should see the Setup Utility.

The Setup Utility checks for the minimum system requirements and also gives you some functionality and security hints.
If the minimum requirements are met, you are presented with a form to fill with some information needed for the application.
The Setup Utility provides some default values that can be modified, and also tries to guess some values like Application URL
and Application Directory.
Please note that all fields are required.

After you fill the form press "Install". If everything goes well, you can start using the application.
Otherwise check that the requirements are met and try again.

Setup is now complete. You can go to the application URL and start building your collection!

Don't forget to remove the write permissions on the configuration file (inc/cfg.inc.php) and to delete the setup/setup.txt file!
